title: Does the follow-up call reduce readmissions?
description: A research paper's discussion as an argument map: the trial result for the claim, two objections to it, a rebuttal of one, and a mechanism.
claim: A nurse call at 48 h reduces 30-day readmissions

points.text: Randomised trial: fewer readmissions in the call arm
Readmission is read from records, not judged by an assessor
Most avoided readmissions were medication errors the call caught
